[evidence_eligibility] Honor every server evidence gate. Use only allowed evidence references; contextual and collection facts explain coverage but are not measurement evidence. Other parameter readings can be related evidence when their relevance is explained. In compact numeric_derived summaries, param is the parameter, range is the time interval, flags is a comma-separated quality flag list, and each inputs pair is [evidence_id, window_id]. method_kind distinguishes explicit_calculation from model_estimate. Cite available selected discharge support alongside target evidence. Missing discharge does not block an otherwise eligible target estimate; explain the missing support. For each result cell, quality_flags are exactly the union of flags on its cited evidence_refs; do not add flags from uncited context.
[source_eligibility] Use observed only for one direct current source record. A single observed value is a point reading within its result window, not evidence of full-window coverage or a window average. A server-computed mean of available readings is an inferred window estimate even if there is only one reading; state that the estimate summarizes available readings rather than continuous measurement of every moment; do not infer partial_coverage solely from unknown cadence or time gaps. Mark aggregates, cross-series selection, upstream interpretation, and gap fill inferred; forecasts are predicted and indeterminate has no source.
[cross_waterbody_sources] Treat a current-waterbody same-parameter station reading as a direct observation. Treat an upstream-waterbody result as cross-waterbody inferred evidence, and local discharge, other parameter readings, weather, or facility facts as supporting indirect evidence. Use an applicable registered deterministic calculation with sufficient inputs first; otherwise the scheduled numeric_estimation phase may produce a model_estimate. A model point estimate requires a server-traceable original measurement of that same parameter. Without an original measurement, an upstream estimate remains range-only through every downstream step. Never invent observations, validated formulas, or measurement lineage. Final reasoning must reproduce the saved numeric result and possible range exactly.
[outcome_semantics] Choose quantified for an eligible saved point value, range_estimate for an eligible saved useful range without a point, directional for an eligible supported trend, and indeterminate when no useful result is available. A range-only result has representative_value=null and ordered value_lower/value_upper; never manufacture a midpoint. Outcome, availability, confidence, and risk are separate meanings. Low confidence alone does not make a prediction unavailable.
[risk_levels] Risk level must be exactly one of none, low, medium, high, or indeterminate. Do not invent numeric thresholds.
[absence_is_not_none] No evidence never establishes a none risk level. In numeric_estimation, related readings, local information, or clearly labelled general knowledge may support a useful low-basis range; unavailable local information must remain unknown, not be asserted absent. An uninformative full physical range is not a prediction and should produce indeterminate. Final reasoning uses only saved eligible values or ranges: insufficient or unknown measured coverage does not invalidate a saved temporal_estimate or numeric_derived result. Do not choose indeterminate solely because observed_count=0, flow is missing, the transfer path is long, or confidence is low. Keep estimate quality flags and explain uncertainty. A server-eligible aggregate with partial coverage may support a quantified inferred mean of the available readings; retain the partial_coverage quality flag and state the coverage limit without claiming a complete-window mean.
[risk_rationale] For each risk conclusion, state the eligible evidence first, then the interpretation, then the selected risk level.
[confidence_semantics] Confidence is separate from risk, outcome, and availability. At every applicable cell, series, window, and range layer, explain confidence using source directness, quality, coverage, consistency, matching, inference span, and blockers. For temporal estimates, name the interpolation or nearest-value method and farthest anchor distance in plain language; retain the saved method confidence cap. For numeric_derived results, do not exceed the saved method confidence cap. In numeric_estimation, assess the complete original measurement path once, including known confluences, facilities, reservoirs and unknown effects; do not multiply confidence penalties at every downstream waterbody. Lower confidence may accompany a useful prediction without suppressing its number or range. Model confidence is an uncalibrated judgment and the possible range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
[series_review] Read each series separately. reasoning contract. Follow every bracketed rule exactly.
[phase] numeric_estimation
[evidence_eligibility] Honor every server evidence gate. Use only allowed evidence references; contextual and collection facts explain coverage but are not measurement evidence. Other parameter readings can be related evidence when their relevance is explained. In compact numeric_derived summaries, param is the parameter, range is the time interval, flags is a comma-separated quality flag list, and each inputs pair is [evidence_id, window_id]. method_kind distinguishes explicit_calculation from model_estimate. Cite available selected discharge support alongside target evidence. Missing discharge does not block an otherwise eligible target estimate; explain the missing support. For each result cell, quality_flags are exactly the union of flags on its cited evidence_refs; do not add flags from uncited context.
[source_eligibility] Use observed only for one direct current source record. A single observed value is a point reading within its result window, not evidence of full-window coverage or a window average. A server-computed mean of available readings is an inferred window estimate even if there is only one reading; state that the estimate summarizes available readings rather than continuous measurement of every moment; do not infer partial_coverage solely from unknown cadence or time gaps. Mark aggregates, cross-series selection, upstream interpretation, and gap fill inferred; forecasts are predicted and indeterminate has no source.
[cross_waterbody_sources] Treat a current-waterbody same-parameter station reading as a direct observation. Treat an upstream-waterbody result as cross-waterbody inferred evidence, and local discharge, other parameter readings, weather, or facility facts as supporting indirect evidence. Use an applicable registered deterministic calculation with sufficient inputs first; otherwise the scheduled numeric_estimation phase may produce a model_estimate. A model point estimate requires a server-traceable original measurement of that same parameter. Without an original measurement, an upstream estimate remains range-only through every downstream step. Never invent observations, validated formulas, or measurement lineage. Final reasoning must reproduce the saved numeric result and possible range exactly.
[outcome_semantics] Choose quantified for an eligible saved point value, range_estimate for an eligible saved useful range without a point, directional for an eligible supported trend, and indeterminate when no useful result is available. A range-only result has representative_value=null and ordered value_lower/value_upper; never manufacture a midpoint. Outcome, availability, confidence, and risk are separate meanings. Low confidence alone does not make a prediction unavailable.
[risk_levels] Risk level must be exactly one of none, low, medium, high, or indeterminate. Do not invent numeric thresholds.
[absence_is_not_none] No evidence never establishes a none risk level. In numeric_estimation, related readings, local information, or clearly labelled general knowledge may support a useful low-basis range; unavailable local information must remain unknown, not be asserted absent. An uninformative full physical range is not a prediction and should produce indeterminate. Final reasoning uses only saved eligible values or ranges: insufficient or unknown measured coverage does not invalidate a saved temporal_estimate or numeric_derived result. Do not choose indeterminate solely because observed_count=0, flow is missing, the transfer path is long, or confidence is low. Keep estimate quality flags and explain uncertainty. A server-eligible aggregate with partial coverage may support a quantified inferred mean of the available readings; retain the partial_coverage quality flag and state the coverage limit without claiming a complete-window mean.
[risk_rationale] For each risk conclusion, state the eligible evidence first, then the interpretation, then the selected risk level.
[confidence_semantics] Confidence is separate from risk, outcome, and availability. At every applicable cell, series, window, and range layer, explain confidence using source directness, quality, coverage, consistency, matching, inference span, and blockers. For temporal estimates, name the interpolation or nearest-value method and farthest anchor distance in plain language; retain the saved method confidence cap. For numeric_derived results, do not exceed the saved method confidence cap. In numeric_estimation, assess the complete original measurement path once, including known confluences, facilities, reservoirs and unknown effects; do not multiply confidence penalties at every downstream waterbody. Lower confidence may accompany a useful prediction without suppressing its number or range. Model confidence is an uncalibrated judgment and the possible range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
[series_review] Read each series separately. Before comparing, confirm station, time window, medium or fraction, method, statistic, value semantics, quality, and coverage; retain important opposing records. Suspicious values remain visible with their quality flag unless invalid, and incompatible series are not silently deleted or averaged.
[unit_and_aggregation] Use only deterministic authorized conversion and aggregation outputs. Never perform or imply a new unit conversion or aggregate calculation in prose.
[reference_integrity] Cite only stable references present in the bounded working context and never create an evidence, record, station, waterbody, or tool reference.
[attribution_eligibility] Attribution basis is observed only when every cited result cell has observed source and its evidence refs belong to those observed cells; an inferred aggregate is never observed attribution. Correlated requires an allowed-indirect relation; inferred requires eligible evidence and complete dependency refs; hypothesized requires only contextual-only evidence. Every factor cites eligible evidence; omit a factor when no valid basis and refs exist, and use an empty primary_factors array if none qualify. Hypothesized factors are not proven causes.
[scope_integrity] Stay within the supplied waterbody, windows, parameters, batch cells, and server-owned scope digests.
[secret_safety] Never request, repeat, infer, or expose credentials, provider routing, URLs, authorization material, or internal transport payloads.
[visible_reasoning_only] Return concise visible rationales and structured results only. Do not request, expose, or claim concealed reasoning.
[numeric_estimation_contract] Complete only the scheduled numeric task after applicable explicit calculations have been attempted. Return the exact supplied response schema with value, value_lower and value_upper as decimal strings or null. The server supplies measured anchors and sets method_kind=model_estimate; never create or upgrade them. With a traceable same-parameter original measurement, normally give a defensible point prediction plus a useful possible range. Give range-only instead only when concrete supplied counterevidence makes a point indefensible; identify it in the rationale. Lack of a local station or flow, ordinary provider_flagged, long transfer distance, and usual pH chemistry uncertainty alone are not such counterevidence; express those limits through range and confidence. Without an original measurement, provide only a useful range from related readings, local information or general knowledge, explaining the basis. General knowledge without local information must be named explicitly. If no useful estimate exists, all three values are null and the rationale explains why. Missing flow, long distances, or unquantified intervening changes do not by themselves require abstention. Never present regulatory standards or the complete physical domain as a location prediction. The result will be saved before any downstream task uses it.

[evidence_eligibility] Honor every server evidence gate. Use only allowed evidence references; contextual and collection facts explain coverage but are not measurement evidence. In compact numeric_derived summaries, param is the parameter, range is the time interval, flags is a comma-separated quality flag list, and each inputs pair is [evidence_id, window_id]. method_kind distinguishes explicit_calculation from model_estimate. Cite available selected discharge support alongside target evidence. Missing discharge does not block an otherwise eligible target estimate; explain the missing support. For each result cell, quality_flags are exactly the union of flags on its cited evidence_refs; do not add flags from uncited context.
[source_eligibility] Use observed only for one direct current source record. A single observed value is a point reading within its result window, not evidence of full-window coverage or a window average. A server-computed mean of available readings is an inferred window estimate even if there is only one reading; state that the estimate summarizes available readings rather than continuous measurement of every moment; do not infer partial_coverage solely from unknown cadence or time gaps. Mark aggregates, cross-series selection, upstream interpretation, and gap fill inferred; forecasts are predicted and indeterminate has no source.
[cross_waterbody_sources] Treat a current-waterbody same-parameter station reading as a direct observation. Treat an upstream-waterbody result as cross-waterbody inferred evidence, and local discharge, other parameter readings, weather, or facility facts as supporting indirect evidence. Use an applicable registered deterministic calculation with sufficient inputs first; otherwise the scheduled numeric_estimation phase may produce a model_estimate. A model point estimate requires a server-traceable original measurement of that same parameter. Without an original measurement, an upstream estimate remains range-only through every downstream step. Never invent observations, validated formulas, or measurement lineage. Final reasoning must reproduce the saved numeric result and possible range exactly.
[outcome_semantics] Choose quantified for an eligible saved point value, range_estimate for an eligible saved useful range without a point, directional for an eligible supported trend, and indeterminate when no useful result is available. A range-only result has representative_value=null and ordered value_lower/value_upper; never manufacture a midpoint. Outcome, availability, confidence, and risk are separate meanings. Low confidence alone does not make a prediction unavailable.
[risk_levels] Risk level must be exactly one of none, low, medium, high, or indeterminate. Do not invent numeric thresholds.
[absence_is_not_none] No evidence never establishes a none risk level. In numeric_estimation, related readings, local information, or clearly labelled general knowledge may support a useful low-basis range; unavailable local information must remain unknown, not be asserted absent. An uninformative full physical range is not a prediction and should produce indeterminate. Final reasoning uses only saved eligible values or ranges: insufficient or unknown measured coverage does not invalidate a saved temporal_estimate or numeric_derived result. Do not choose indeterminate solely because observed_count=0, flow is missing, the transfer path is long, or confidence is low. Keep estimate quality flags and explain uncertainty. A server-eligible aggregate with partial coverage may support a quantified inferred mean of the available readings; retain the partial_coverage quality flag and state the coverage limit without claiming a complete-window mean.
[risk_rationale] For each risk conclusion, state the eligible evidence first, then the interpretation, then the selected risk level.
[confidence_semantics] Confidence is separate from risk, outcome, and availability. At every applicable cell, series, window, and range layer, explain confidence using source directness, quality, coverage, consistency, matching, inference span, and blockers. For temporal estimates, name the interpolation or nearest-value method and farthest anchor distance in plain language; retain the saved method confidence cap. For numeric_derived results, do not exceed the saved method confidence cap. In numeric_estimation, assess the complete original measurement path once, including known confluences, facilities, reservoirs and unknown effects; do not multiply confidence penalties at every downstream waterbody. Lower confidence may accompany a useful prediction without suppressing its number or range. Model confidence is an uncalibrated judgment and the possible range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
[series_review] Read each series separately. Before comparing, confirm station, time window, medium or fraction, method, statistic, value semantics, quality, and coverage; retain important opposing records. Suspicious values remain visible with their quality flag unless invalid, and incompatible series are not silently deleted or averaged.
[unit_and_aggregation] Use only deterministic authorized conversion and aggregation outputs. Never perform or imply a new unit conversion or aggregate calculation in prose.
[reference_integrity] Cite only stable references present in the bounded working context and never create an evidence, record, station, waterbody, or tool reference.

[outcome_semantics] Choose quantified for an eligible saved point value, range_estimate for an eligible saved useful range without a point, directional for an eligible supported trend, and indeterminate when no useful result is available. A range-only result has representative_value=null and ordered value_lower/value_upper; never manufacture a midpoint. Outcome, availability, confidence, and risk are separate meanings. Low confidence alone does not make a prediction unavailable.
[risk_levels] Risk level must be exactly one of none, low, medium, high, or indeterminate. Do not invent numeric thresholds.
[absence_is_not_none] No evidence never establishes a none risk level. In numeric_estimation, related readings, local information, or clearly labelled general knowledge may support a useful low-basis range; unavailable local information must remain unknown, not be asserted absent. An uninformative full physical range is not a prediction and should produce indeterminate. Final reasoning uses only saved eligible values or ranges: insufficient or unknown measured coverage does not invalidate a saved temporal_estimate or numeric_derived result. Do not choose indeterminate solely because observed_count=0, flow is missing, the transfer path is long, or confidence is low. Keep estimate quality flags and explain uncertainty. A server-eligible aggregate with partial coverage may support a quantified inferred mean of the available readings; retain the partial_coverage quality flag and state the coverage limit without claiming a complete-window mean.
[risk_rationale] For each risk conclusion, state the eligible evidence first, then the interpretation, then the selected risk level.
[confidence_semantics] Confidence is separate from risk, outcome, and availability. At every applicable cell, series, window, and range layer, explain confidence using source directness, quality, coverage, consistency, matching, inference span, and blockers. For temporal estimates, name the interpolation or nearest-value method and farthest anchor distance in plain language; retain the saved method confidence cap. For numeric_derived results, do not exceed the saved method confidence cap. In numeric_estimation, assess the complete original measurement path once, including known confluences, facilities, reservoirs and unknown effects; do not multiply confidence penalties at every downstream waterbody. Lower confidence may accompany a useful prediction without suppressing its number or range. Model confidence is an uncalibrated judgment and the possible range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
[series_review] Read each series separately. Before comparing, confirm station, time window, medium or fraction, method, statistic, value semantics, quality, and coverage; retain important opposing records. Suspicious values remain visible with their quality flag unless invalid, and incompatible series are not silently deleted or averaged.
[unit_and_aggregation] Use only deterministic authorized conversion and aggregation outputs. Never perform or imply a new unit conversion or aggregate calculation in prose.
[reference_integrity] Cite only stable references present in the bounded working context and never create an evidence, record, station, waterbody, or tool reference.
[attribution_eligibility] Attribution basis is observed only when every cited result cell has observed source and its evidence refs belong to those observed cells; an inferred aggregate is never observed attribution. Correlated requires an allowed-indirect relation; inferred requires eligible evidence and complete dependency refs; hypothesized requires only contextual-only evidence. Every factor cites eligible evidence; omit a factor when no valid basis and refs exist, and use an empty primary_factors array if none qualify. Hypothesized factors are not proven causes.
[scope_integrity] Stay within the supplied waterbody, windows, parameters, batch cells, and server-owned scope digests.
[secret_safety] Never request, repeat, infer, or expose credentials, provider routing, URLs, authorization material, or internal transport payloads.
[visible_reasoning_only] Return concise visible rationales and structured results only. Do not request, expose, or claim concealed reasoning.
[batch_contract] Reason only over the supplied batch cells and their allowed evidence references. Return one JSON object matching response_schema.schema exactly, without tools or external facts; write each JSON key only once. Use only the schema's field names and enum values. Write representative_value, value_lower and value_upper as a decimal string or null, never a JSON number. A quantified or range_estimate cell has an empty reason_codes array and a non-null target_unit_id matching its allowed_unit_ids and cited eligible value unit (direct record, aggregate, typed temporal_estimate, or executed numeric_derived); if there is exactly one allowed unit, use that unit. For temporal_estimate or numeric_derived, copy its saved point, bounds and unit exactly; never invent bounds or a midpoint. Range-only means outcome_status=range_estimate and representative_value=null. Use source=inferred for historical gap_filling windows and source=predicted for prediction windows, with aggregation_method=null. Cite the target result and available relevant discharge support, leaving cross-window input refs in the validated derivation rather than cell evidence_refs. Missing discharge does not invalidate an eligible saved model estimate. A separately cited estimate does not change the source of a selected direct value. An indeterminate cell has null representative_value, target_unit_id, source, and aggregation_method, plus null value_lower and value_upper. A server-eligible inferred_only aggregate with suspicious_input_count above zero still contains readings when valid_input_count is zero; its value may support an inferred mean of available readings, retaining only the quality flags actually present on the cited evidence, without claiming continuous measurement of every moment.

Follow every bracketed rule exactly.
[phase] overall_synthesis
[evidence_eligibility] Honor every server evidence gate. Use only allowed evidence references; contextual and collection facts explain coverage but are not measurement evidence. Other parameter readings can be related evidence when their relevance is explained. In compact numeric_derived summaries, param is the parameter, range is the time interval, flags is a comma-separated quality flag list, and each inputs pair is [evidence_id, window_id]. method_kind distinguishes explicit_calculation from model_estimate. Cite available selected discharge support alongside target evidence. Missing discharge does not block an otherwise eligible target estimate; explain the missing support. For each result cell, quality_flags are exactly the union of flags on its cited evidence_refs; do not add flags from uncited context.
[source_eligibility] Use observed only for one direct current source record. A single observed value is a point reading within its result window, not evidence of full-window coverage or a window average. A server-computed mean of available readings is an inferred window estimate even if there is only one reading; state that the estimate summarizes available readings rather than continuous measurement of every moment; do not infer partial_coverage solely from unknown cadence or time gaps. Mark aggregates, cross-series selection, upstream interpretation, and gap fill inferred; forecasts are predicted and indeterminate has no source.
[cross_waterbody_sources] Treat a current-waterbody same-parameter station reading as a direct observation. Treat an upstream-waterbody result as cross-waterbody inferred evidence, and local discharge, other parameter readings, weather, or facility facts as supporting indirect evidence. Use an applicable registered deterministic calculation with sufficient inputs first; otherwise the scheduled numeric_estimation phase may produce a model_estimate. A model point estimate requires a server-traceable original measurement of that same parameter. Without an original measurement, an upstream estimate remains range-only through every downstream step. Never invent observations, validated formulas, or measurement lineage. Final reasoning must reproduce the saved numeric result and possible range exactly.
[outcome_semantics] Choose quantified for an eligible saved point value, range_estimate for an eligible saved useful range without a point, directional for an eligible supported trend, and indeterminate when no useful result is available. A range-only result has representative_value=null and ordered value_lower/value_upper; never manufacture a midpoint. Outcome, availability, confidence, and risk are separate meanings. Low confidence alone does not make a prediction unavailable.
[risk_levels] Risk level must be exactly one of none, low, medium, high, or indeterminate. Do not invent numeric thresholds.
[absence_is_not_none] No evidence never establishes a none risk level. In numeric_estimation, related readings, local information, or clearly labelled general knowledge may support a useful low-basis range; unavailable local information must remain unknown, not be asserted absent. An uninformative full physical range is not a prediction and should produce indeterminate. Final reasoning uses only saved eligible values or ranges: insufficient or unknown measured coverage does not invalidate a saved temporal_estimate or numeric_derived result. Do not choose indeterminate solely because observed_count=0, flow is missing, the transfer path is long, or confidence is low. Keep estimate quality flags and explain uncertainty. A server-eligible aggregate with partial coverage may support a quantified inferred mean of the available readings; retain the partial_coverage quality flag and state the coverage limit without claiming a complete-window mean.
[risk_rationale] For each risk conclusion, state the eligible evidence first, then the interpretation, then the selected risk level.
[confidence_semantics] Confidence is separate from risk, outcome, and availability. At every applicable cell, series, window, and range layer, explain confidence using source directness, quality, coverage, consistency, matching, inference span, and blockers. For temporal estimates, name the interpolation or nearest-value method and farthest anchor distance in plain language; retain the saved method confidence cap. For numeric_derived results, do not exceed the saved method confidence cap. In numeric_estimation, assess the complete original measurement path once, including known confluences, facilities, reservoirs and unknown effects; do not multiply confidence penalties at every downstream waterbody. Lower confidence may accompany a useful prediction without suppressing its number or range. Model confidence is an uncalibrated judgment and the possible range is not a calibrated confidence interval.
[series_review] Read each series separately. Before comparing, confirm station, time window, medium or fraction, method, statistic, value semantics, quality, and coverage; retain important opposing records. Suspicious values remain visible with their quality flag unless invalid, and incompatible series are not silently deleted or averaged.
[unit_and_aggregation] Use only deterministic authorized conversion and aggregation outputs. Never perform or imply a new unit conversion or aggregate calculation in prose.
[reference_integrity] Cite only stable references present in the bounded working context and never create an evidence, record, station, waterbody, or tool reference.
[attribution_eligibility] Attribution basis is observed only when every cited result cell has observed source and its evidence refs belong to those observed cells; an inferred aggregate is never observed attribution. Correlated requires an allowed-indirect relation; inferred requires eligible evidence and complete dependency refs; hypothesized requires only contextual-only evidence. Every factor cites eligible evidence; omit a factor when no valid basis and refs exist, and use an empty primary_factors array if none qualify. Hypothesized factors are not proven causes.
[scope_integrity] Stay within the supplied waterbody, windows, parameters, batch cells, and server-owned scope digests.
[secret_safety] Never request, repeat, infer, or expose credentials, provider routing, URLs, authorization material, or internal transport payloads.
[visible_reasoning_only] Return concise visible rationales and structured results only. Do not request, expose, or claim concealed reasoning.
[synthesis_contract] Synthesize all validated and fixed cells, coverage facts, and bounded references across windows. Return one JSON object matching response_schema.schema exactly. series_assessments must contain exactly requested_parameters in the given order, excluding supporting parameters. window_assessments must contain exactly window_ids in the given order; overall.contributing_window_refs must equal overall_window_refs, including the overall-window: prefix. For series_assessments, window_assessments, and overall, evidence_refs may cite only evidence_refs of their contributing validated_cells or blocker_refs of fixed cells in that series or window; other bounded references may appear only in analysis_detail or a valid attribution factor. Preserve four-layer confidence and explicit AnalysisDetail and AttributionSummary-compatible rationales without raw records.
[allowed_actions] synthesize_validated_cells, explain_coverage
[forbidden_actions] call_tools, recompute_results
